en: O Goddess worshipped by the *sumanas* flowers, O beautiful one, O sister of the spring moon (*mādhavīcandra*), O you who reside in gold, O you adorned by hosts of sages, O bestower of liberation, O sweet-spoken one praised by the Vedas; O dweller in the lotus, O showerer of excellent virtues worshipped by the gods, O you endowed with peace—Victory, victory to you, O Madhusūdanakāminī, O primordial Lakṣmī! Protect me always. (1)

O Ahikali, destroyer of impurity, O Kāminī, whose form is Vedic and who consists of the Vedas; O you born from the ocean of milk, embodiment of auspiciousness, abode of mantras, praised by mantras; O bestower of blessings, dweller in the lotus, whose feet are resorted to by the hosts of gods—Victory, victory to you, O Madhusūdana! O Kāminī, Dhānyalakṣmī, protect me always. 2.

Victory, O excellent lady! O Vaiṣṇavī, whose very nature is the Bhārgava mantra, who consists of mantra! You who are worshipped by the hosts of gods, who grant swift fruit and expand wisdom, and who are praised in the scriptures; you who remove the fear of worldly existence, who liberate from sin, and whose feet are resorted to by the virtuous—victory, victory to you! O Madhusūdana, O Lakṣmī of the heart's desires, protect me always. 3.
The Auspicious Fortune of the Elephant (Gajalakṣmī)

Victory, victory to you, O destroyer of misfortune! O bestower of all fruits upon those who desire them! O you who consist of the sacred scriptures! O you adorned by a retinue of attendants surrounded by chariots, elephants, horses, and foot-soldiers! O you praised by the world! O you whose feet are worshipped and served by Hari, Hara, and Brahmā, and who dispel the heat of suffering! Victory, victory to you, O golden-hued one, O sustainer of the earth! Protect me in the form of Lakṣmī, the beloved of the elephant-like Viṣṇu! 4.

O you who delude the serpent and the bird, who increase the passion of the wielder of the discus, who are composed of pure knowledge; O ocean of a multitude of virtues, who desire the welfare of the world, whose singing is adorned by the seven musical notes—I praise you! O you whose feet are worshipped by all the gods, asuras, celestial sages, and lords of men; victory, victory to you, O Madhusūdana! O Lakṣmī, who brings an end to the desires of the passionate, protect me! 5.

Victory to you, O dweller of the lotus, bestower of the supreme goal, who expands knowledge and consists of song! You who are daily worshipped, adorned with the grey hue of saffron, fragrant, and praised by musical instruments; you whose glory is lauded by the Earth and the Golden Mountain (Meru), and whose feet are honored by Śaṅkara and the Teacher (Brahmā)! Victory, victory to you, O Madhusūdana! O Lakṣmī, the conqueror of desire, protect me forever! 6.

O Goddess of the lords of gods, saluted! O Bhāratī, daughter of Bhṛgu, destroyer of sorrow! O you who are composed of jewels! O you whose smiling face is encompassed by the peace of ornaments upon ears adorned with gems! O giver of the nine treasures, remover of the impurities of the Kali age, endowed with hands that bestow immeasurable fruits! Victory, victory to you, O Madhusūdanakāminī, O Vidyā-Lakṣmī! Protect me always! (7)

O You who are filled with the deep resonance of the *dhimi-dhimi* and *dhiṃdhiṃ* sounds of the great drum; O You whose music is beautifully played by the conch shells sounding *ghumaghuma*, *ghuṅghuma*, and *ghuṅghuma*; O You who are well-honored by the Vedas, Purāṇas, and Itihāsas, and who reveal the path of the Vedic way—victory, victory to You, O Madhusūdana! Protect me in the form of Lakṣmī, the destroyer of desire. 8.
